blockers.error: B1: CPU/GPU execution of the lowered text plan cannot be tested: no crate may depend on hsk-studio-composite AND hsk-studio-render-cpu/render-gpu (root allowed lists; composite's closure test bans render-* even as dev-deps). Lead decision needed: (a) allow render-cpu and render-gpu a dev-dependency on composite for parity tests, or (b) a steward-owned tool/test crate allowed to depend on composite + both renderers, or (c) grant this lane render-cpu/render-gpu test files to rebuild the same plan shape from hsk-studio-type (both renderers may depend on type) and compare CPU vs GPU within TOL_PER_LAYER. Renderers need no product change: Solid (Exact) and Mask(coverage_u8) are existing routes with parity tests in render-gpu tests/gpu_plan.rs.

G1 (Folio gap, not composite): a text source cannot feed a group composite: Folio requires source.value_type == target.value_type and a group input is image while a text source outputs text (folio src/lib.rs ~887). So 'text over another layer with blend' is not authorable; text renders as its own graph output (root). Owner decision: Folio text->image conversion operation or image-typed text sources.

next: Lead: decide B1 (renderer parity route) and G1 (Folio edge typing for text). Then: CPU digest via render-cpu + GPU parity within TOL_PER_LAYER; text inside groups; paragraph text from layout line boxes (one TextRun per placed line already supported); extended (records) entry point with text.
